title: Composed majority on a Boolean cube
statement: For a natural number $m$, identify the $2+(2m+1)$ coordinates of the Boolean cube with two signs and a block of $2m+1$ signs. The composed majority function applies majority to the block and then takes three-input majority of that output and the two remaining signs.
